statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-6612 (CVE-2026-78663) affects HTTP/2 server stream flow-control refund logic in net/http.Server. In this container, /usr/local/bin/gh (GitHub CLI 2.97.0) functions strictly as a client for GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs; its OAuth callback listener operates over plain HTTP/1.1 on loopback without TLS/ALPN or h2c, so the HTTP/2 server stream handler is unreachable. /usr/bin/yq (4.53.3-r2) is an offline command-line YAML/JSON processor with no network listening capabilities. The vulnerable server code paths are demonstrably unreachable. The signed Alpine r2 rebuild uses patched Go 1.26.9; the yq x/net module remains v0.55.0 with the same CLI-only server-unreachable assessment. Exact new binary identities are documented in docs/development/yq-go-4.53.3-r2-review.md.

GO-2026-6604 (CVE-2026-56857) affects Windows-specific os.Root directory junction traversal implemented in internal/syscall/windows. This container image strictly targets linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 environments with Alpine musl, utilizing native Linux openat syscalls. The Windows-specific junction resolution code is non-applicable and cannot execute under Linux.

This is the official CVE alias of GO-2026-6612, emitted separately by NVD/CPE matching. The unchanged exact reviewed gh 2.97.0 bytes use GitHub client APIs and a loopback HTTP/1.1 OAuth callback, not an HTTP/2 server. Apply only to the validated gh stdlib go1.26.5 identity; no rule applies to patched yq stdlib or unknown binaries.

Official CVE alias of GO-2026-6604. The Windows-specific os.Root directory junction path cannot execute in these Linux images. This rule remains bound to exact reviewed gh stdlib go1.26.5 bytes and validated image/SBOM identity; patched yq stdlib and unknown binaries get no rule.

CVE-2026-58016 affects g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml in GNOME GLib when parsing malformed D-Bus introspection XML. This container image runs headless Chromium, OpenSSH, and Node.js without a D-Bus daemon or any untrusted D-Bus XML introspection parsing. The vulnerable function is demonstrably unreachable in this container.
